description: Get basic information about a Compute Engine instance template, including its name, ID, description, machine type, region, and creation timestamp. Requires project and instance template name as input.

inputSchema.description: Request message for getting instance template basic info.

name.description: Required. Identifier. Name of the instance template to return.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

name: get_instance_template_basic_info

outputSchema.description: InstanceTemplateBasicInfo contains basic information about an instance template.

createTime.description: Creation timestamp of the instance template.

id.description: The unique identifier for the instance template.

machineType.description: The machine type of the instance template.

region.description: The region of the instance template if it is a regional resource.
